chunks: 2741 - Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

“When you have completed your saʿy and you are a mutamattiʿ, then trim from the hair of your head, from its sides, and your beard, and take from your mustache, and clip your nails, while leaving some of them for your hajj. Then when you have done that, you have come out of iḥrām from everything from which the muḥrim becomes released. So perform tawaf of the House voluntarily as much as you wish.”

key_terms.أَحْلَلْتَ: you have exited iḥrām and become released
key_terms.سَعْيِكَ: your saʿy, the ritual walking between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah
key_terms.ٱلْمُحْرِمُ: the person in the state of iḥrām

ai.seo_question: What should a mutamattiʿ do after completing saʿy to exit iḥrām?
ai.summary: This hadith gives the ruling for the mutamattiʿ after completing the saʿy: he should perform taqsir by trimming hair, beard, mustache, and nails. By doing so, he exits the restrictions of iḥrām and may then perform voluntary tawaf of the Kaʿbah as he wishes.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2741 - Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:

"When you have completed your sa’i (ritual walking) and you are performing tamattu' (Hajj), trim the hair from the sides of your head, your beard, and your mustache, and clip your nails, leaving some for your Hajj. When you do this, you are released from all the restrictions of ihram, just as a person who has exited ihram. Then, perform as many voluntary tawaf (circuits around the Kaaba) as you wish."
